segments.text: This paper combines classical Islamic legal theory with applied areas such as criminal law, family law, contracts, banking, international law and human rights. The best method is to separate sources/usul from substantive rules.

items.text: Start with sources and jurisprudence because they explain the logic of later rules.
Use Arabic legal terms with a plain-English meaning the first time they appear.
Distinguish classical doctrine from Pakistani statutory law.
For statutory topics, consult the current official text and leading Pakistani cases.

segments.text: Study sources and usul first because they explain how later rules are derived. Then cover criminal, family and commercial law. For Pakistan-specific statutes, clearly separate classical doctrine from the law actually enacted and applied by courts.
